items.title: Inference usage
items.detail: Usage leads with actual Ori-key spend today, its credit limit, and separately reported provider-billed costs. Historical model and session estimates expand under Detailed breakdown.

items.title: Ori spend in the title bar
items.detail: The Ori badge shows the key's UTC-day spend and opens Usage. Work-host estimates stay separate.

limits: The key's credit limit excludes BYOK charges when OpenRouter reports that setting. Provider-side remaining budget is not reported.
